load_vision_transformer_model: load a pretrained VisionTransformer model by name using __model_loader__ with a specified device
build_vit_huge_patch14: build a ViT-H model with patch size 14 and 1280 embedding dimensions using vit_huge_patch14
build_vit_giant_patch16: build a ViT-G model with patch size 16 and 1408 embedding dimensions using vit_giant_patch16
create_sincos_positional_embedding: create 2D sinusoidal positional embeddings for a given grid size and embedding dimension using get_2d_sincos_pos_embed
run_drop_path_regularization: run stochastic depth drop path regularization on a tensor using the DropPath module
